claude._note: Uses your Claude Code sign-in from ~/.claude/.credentials.json. Nothing to paste here.

codex._note: Uses your OpenCode ChatGPT sign-in first, then Codex CLI as a fallback. Nothing to paste here.

openrouter._note: A management key shows your account balance. A regular key shows that key's own limit.

local._note: Counts tokens you run on local models (Ollama's log, OpenCode). price_per_million is in USD and only feeds the estimate.
